runtime.command_template: python -B tools/run_pinmame_harness.py --library <pinned-pinmame64.dll> --game <set> --rom-path <vpinmame-roms> --work-dir <run>/state --scenario tools/harness-scenarios/system-11/cycln-nvram-init.json --output <run>/init.json, then the same command with --scenario tools/harness-scenarios/system-11/cycln-<name>.json --output <run>/run.json in the same, newly created state directory. Diagnostic scenarios wait 8 s, set Manual-Down (-6 = 0), pulse Advance (-7) to enter the tests, set Auto-Up (-6 = 1) and pulse Advance until the test's title is displayed.

coil-test-l1.limitation: A pulsed address is ROM activity, not proof that a load is fitted: steps 02, 06, 08 and 22 pulse drives the ROM names NOT USED.
coil-test-l1.note: Advance walk to COIL TEST (player 3 display 05), then two identical cycles of 28 pulses. Step:address = player 1 and 2 displays [player 4 display]: 01:1 = OUTHOLE ['A'51dE]; 01:25 = L.FERRIS JACKPOT ['C'51dE]; 02:2 = NOT USED ['A'51dE]; 02:26 = R.FERRIS C. TEETH ['C'51dE]; 03:3 = SHUTTLE KICKER ['A'51dE]; 03:27 = BCK. MID. L. EYE ['C'51dE]; 04:4 = BOMERNG. KICKER ['A'51dE]; 04:28 = CATS F.L. B. FIREW. ['C'51dE]; 05:5 = C. DROP TARGET ['A'51dE]; 05:29 = DUCK F.L. R. FIREW. ['C'51dE]; 06:6 = NOT USED ['A'51dE]; 06:30 = FERRIS FLASHER ['C'51dE]; 07:7 = KNOCKER ['A'51dE]; 07:31 = TOP RIT. R. EYE ['C'51dE]; 08:8 = NOT USED ['A'51dE]; 08:32 = SPOOK H. L. FIREW. ['C'51dE]; 09:9 = SPIN M.W. FLASHER; 10:10 = PLAYFLD. G.I.; 11:11 = BACKBOX G.I.; 12:12 = A/C SELECT; 15:15 = BOMERNG. 12S1; 16:16 = FERRIS WHEEL; 17:17 = LEFT JET; 18:18 = LEFT KICKER; 19:19 = RIGHT JET; 20:20 = RIGHT KICKER; 21:21 = BOTTOM JET; 22:22 = NOT USED. Steps 01-08 pulse the A-side address n with the A/C select relay (12) released and then, with 12 energized, the C-side address n+24 (25, 26, 27, 28, 29, 30, 31, 32); step 12 pulses 12 itself; steps 13 and 14 are skipped.

source.attribution: Generated locally from pinned PinMAME and the user-authorized ROM corpus; ROM bytes and NVRAM remain external.
source.manifest_algorithm: source.sha256 is SHA-256 of manifest.json's exact bytes. manifest.json is compact canonical JSON with sorted keys, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False, plus one LF, of {files: [{path, sha256, size}], format: 'pinmame-external-evidence-manifest', game, version: 1}; files lists every file under source.path recursively (each run directory's init.json, init.log, run.json and run.log and every state-directory file, including the NVRAM the initialization wrote and the run then rewrote) except manifest.json and manifest.sha256, sorted by POSIX relative path. tools/build_external_evidence_manifest.py writes and re-checks it.
